summary: Re-test of iteration_70 fixes for language onboarding + account language sync (LIVE account hostbay@moxx.co). Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass in /app/tests/test_language_sync_api.py (login JWT, profile auth guard, idempotent language-only PUT, unsupported code -> 400, fr persistence, empty body -> 400, cleanup to en). Frontend Playwright: FIX1 (bar hides after in-session login), FIX3 (French toast + French UI), FIX4 (login-email-input testid) and full regression (fresh-anon bar with localized headline + 6 chips, FR pick sets lang/lang_onboard, bar hides and does not reappear on reload, cross-device auto-French after clearing localStorage and re-login) ALL PASS. CLEANUP DONE: account language reset to 'en' via /settings UI and re-verified via GET /api/user/profile (data.language==='en').

issues: Minor i18n gaps: some strings remain English while UI is French - 'Applies to your whole account' (Settings profile header chip), 'Payment links' quick-action button on dashboard, 'VOLUME · 7 DAYS', 'vs previous period · 16 payments', tier name 'Growth'. Cosmetic only, not part of this fix round.

action_items: Optional: translate remaining hardcoded English strings on dashboard/settings (see design_issues).
critical_code_review_comments: LanguageOnboardingBar gating effect (router.pathname + window focus) correctly hides the bar on client-side login; verified live.

updateProfile(): language-only unchanged path returns 200 with full profile, unsupported base code returns 400 before any write - matches spec. Note the 200 no-op path skips Redis cache invalidation, which is fine since nothing changed.
seed_data_creation: None. Only tbl_user.language toggled on the authorized live account; restored to 'en'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 fixes + regressions verified July 2026. Reusable API suite: /app/tests/test_language_sync_api.py (run with `python -m pytest tests/test_language_sync_api.py -o addopts=''` from /app). UI login flow: fill [data-testid=login-email-input] -> Continue -> [data-testid=password-input] -> [data-testid=signin-submit-btn]. /settings MUI select needs ~500ms after open before clicking [data-testid=language-option-XX]. Account language left as 'en'.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - all previously reported defects (non-idempotent language PUT, silent coercion of unsupported codes, onboarding bar persisting after in-session login, English toast, missing login email testid) are resolved and verified.
